text: The game starts of with a fun single player campaign (hence the second star). But, there is city building. And that means multiplayer. Which means, as with all these games, after a few days your shield comes down and you can't log in without messages of 3 attacks in a few hours and cannot build an army or resources without spending money. Wish someone would allow you to opt out of this predatory multiplayer system that's been going for years and nobody wants.

I think the game is good and in depth. some of the "heroes" are hotties ❣️ however it is in fact a Pay To Win type of game, hence why there's no ads. you've no chance to progress without paying, got my base to level 8 and could see the wood through the trees. the gameplay is somewhat accurate to the advertising but not entirely, the biggest flaw has to be that you can't progress without paying and the biggest spenders will be the winners of the game,I'd prefer to see an offline full copy

I've played for many hours 2/3 hours a day for a few months and not spent a thing so I could give my honest review of this game. I can tell you that this game is a standard money grab game, gives you some gameplay which is okay but the whole point is to extract as much money from you as possible, every new "event" they add is just another way for them to put more Ads in your face, to try and entice you, you can play without paying but it becomes more and more difficult as time progresses.

Advertising states that 100% of the gameplay is the running & gunning game it shows in the advert. This couldn't be further from the truth. At the start it's maybe 50% of the gameplay (at best) with the other 50% being a subpar base builder like you've seen a hundred times before. The run & gun aspect starts to disappear slowly as you progress through the game. By the time you get your base to level 18 pretty much 100% of the game is the subpar base builder. This game is incredibly dull....

Deceiving The ads make it look like a game where you have to think fast to choose the correct panel, but it's not. It's a classic strategy game, where you have to gather resources, spend them on building and upgrading, etc Very fast you'll become blocked by the time it takes to upgrade, unless you spend actual real life money. The game itself is not that interesting or good.

it's amazing game however, there's one bit which annoying, if you send your army to attack on the event, it says 15 minutes, when you go back to your HQ and go the event again it starts from the beginning, i work 5 days a week 10hrs a day. do you think I have time to keep it on constantly and wait,let it do it's thing in the background just same as when you upgrade or build. that small thing is annoying. fix the minor issues or I'm just gonna pass on this game.

money spending simulator, complete pay to win. We've reached the point where one player can hold off an entire server, just because they've spent so much money. Edit - spending just gets worse, I don't mind paying a bit to play a game, but unless you're dropping a 1k dollars a month on this game, you will fall behind. Cosmetic skins for your base costing over 500 dollars is outrageous.

Title: Fun at first, but turns into a paywall nightmare At first, I really enjoyed the game — great graphics, fun heroes, and exciting battles. But after a while, it becomes ridiculously hard, no matter how much progress you make. Even if you spend money and get S-Class heroes, the difficulty spikes so fast that you’re basically forced to keep spending just to keep up. The balance feels totally off — it’s less about skill and more about how deep your wallet is. It’s frustrating.

The game is not completely like the ads. Even the bulky guy in the thumbnail isn't part of the game. The arcade shooting and sweeping parts are fun when they are available. After 3 hours it would be impossible to continue without paying and you won't be able to progress with the game without spending hours collecting resources that are so scarce. The 'service' or paid parts of the game are very expensive and almost entirely needed to enjoy the game without hustle and stress. What a shame!

Lies. Played Last War for over a year, not really knowing why I stuck it out that long, having been initially led there from their ads which suggested it would be a shooter game when in reality the interaction with the game mode they show in the ads is very limited. Saw the ads for this game which actually mock other similar games that use this tactic, promising Last Z is different (it isn't) - and to make it even more shameless, this has the name 'shooter' in the title. Should have guessed...

Fun elements to the game, like the main combat, and the special ops. These bits look like what you see in the Ads, however... they always add this rubbish/constructive base building gameplay in it. it's not particularly fun, and it stops you from playing the actual fun but. 'Want to keep battling? Not untill your base reaches level 10!, and to do that you'll need to upgrade other buildings first!' 😖 ruins the gameplay.

It's better than others in this genre in terms of longevity, but like them, it quickly shifts away from the gameplay that drew you in. It turns into a resource-gathering grind, pushing you toward spending money. There needs to be a better balance I don’t mind spending a few pounds now and then, but not on a game that takes the fun out of it

This game's lame, too many limitations to progress, there no doubt to try and force you to waste money on it. Decided to uninstall. Also noted bug, got stuck in some alliance messaging system, the arrow to exit was right over a tab, and wouldn't activate - this needs addressing guys. Had to exit the game entirely. That was the last straw for me. Can't help but feel these games are a major cash cow verses gaming on something like an Xbox or PC.

Don't believe the ads.. So if you came looking for the game in the ads you are going to be disappointed. It does kind of feature but not in the way you want. If you've played any other town builder games etc this is basically what it is and the main conquest missions feature that mode BUT it's not as the ads show it to be. You can go through labels but they don't have any impact or change the outcome of the fight, it's all about the hero power as is raid, clash etc. Don't waste your time.

I saw adverts on Facebook saying they were sorry the game didn't match the adverts, but this game does, so I installed this... Yes, you get the shooting action shown by the ads but the VAST majority of the game is building and upgrading your base. You CANNOT upgrade the heroes who do the shooting parts without upgrading your HQ. You CANNOT beat certain levels until you upgrade your heroes. See the problem? It's utter tedium for the most part.

Good Fun But Gave Up After Persistent Attacks. Can enjoy this game without spending as you can exit game and your buildings will still "grow" whilst offline. Good graphics and detail. However, gave up after an Alliance decided to keep attacking me and regularly setting me back a long way. I know it's a feature of the game but as I couldn't progress, Ilost interest. Yes, you can buy a defence against that, but I was not up for that. A manual online would also help to explain some details.

Same publishers as Dark War Survival and, look at that, their marketing is also deceptive and spams annoying ads at me. It's not nearly as bad but what looks like a fun little RPG/Shoot em up with multiple modes is just another boring survival game grind that occasionally become a shmup. The actual shooting stages have no tactical depth whatsoever, I've beaten stages by just moving left and right randomly and by standing on one side the whole time. Terrible. Just play R-Type or something

I have never played a game with so many issues in the software and gameplay. You try and progress you get stopped. You try to gather supplies and you are prevented so your shelter gets plundered multiple times. All you get is an unknown error message. The extra problem so many players are experiencing is the server maintenance update. Why are we not getting advanced notifications of the schedule of this routine. Because of this failure to inform players it is costing us all rewards.

The game isn't clickbait as I expected but it's just so boring. There's so much and so little going on at the same time. There's too many "storylines" going on at the same time. The actual game play that you see in the ads is really boring and then sometimes you get stuck having to wait hours to play that part because you have to upgrade a lot of things before you can play. Don't waste your timem

The game is fun and does add a little extra to increase base space, which gives a bit more to do outside of building and attacking. Like others in the genre it relies heavily on spending to be competitive. Sadly the pricing is extreme and the first 24 hours saw offers totalling over £1000 all of which combined would still not give you overall control. It is fun though, but pricing needs to be heavily adjusted and number of offers toned down.

The game is not as advertised. 10% of it is what is advertised, the rest is a carbon copy war game like Lords Mobile. Would not recommend it to anyone that is just looking for a casual game. Stronger players who spend money bully you and steal everything you build. The game doesn't even offer shields for weaker players to protect themselves. And the shields on offer is so expensive no one can afford them. I'd give a zero rating if I could. Very disappointed.

started off as a fun zombie shooter and becomes more and more about building cities. After 2 - 3 weeks, this game is 90% Upgrade these building, which is great if you're into the farmtown vibe. If you're just looking for a zombie shooter you will get bored upgrading endless buildings and play less or uninstall. This is a strategy building game with a little zombie shooting along the way. it's gonna get boring for some people real quick, unless you pay hard cash to skip the slow building stuff.

I wouldn’t even rate this game 1 star if that were possible.I initially installed it for the zombie gameplay, but after the first few days, it becomes a tedious waiting game.My daily routine now consists of opening the app,collecting the login rewards, upgrading a building,and then closing it for another few hours as each building upgrade takes few hours. The zombie action advertised is only present in the initial stages;afterward,it turns into a slow paced city building simulator with no action

Classic pay to progress strategy, at the start, players may find it overwhelming because there are so many features to learn and unlock, perseverance is key here. Initially progress is fast paced, then it quickly turns into a daily grind. If you have the patience to labour your way through the endless repetition to attain might, then it's rewarding, if not stay clear. Players willing to part with their cash have a distinct advantage.

This is a city building game like an improvement of Evony. Nearly everything is identical. The paywall is hard, but it is so expensive that you cannot actually consider giving so much money for a game, it'd be straight up moronic, which allows you to play only for like an hour a day which is actually good for time management. If that's your thing, this game is for you.

Game is so expensive to buy things HQ skin £600 other things expensive £10 to £100 price range . if HQ skin and other things cheap people will buy things I dont mind paying for things in game but way too much . Events thing should be free but no so expensive cant have fun . if I want to spend £600 I buy diamond ring to my love one. Last Z losing millions because everything so expensive and people interest. Thank for reading

The point of any game is to make money for the creators. In this game you are just food for those who spent lots on the upgrades that you need to progress unless you join them. The game was entertaining at the beginning but has just descended into a grind with little reward. Be prepared to hit a wall where your progress slows to nothing only to see it all taken by someone 50 levels higher than you who has paid for premium characters.

This game is advertised as a shooting game and heavily promoted as such on social media. At first it plays like one, but after a certain point you’re dragged into a base-building grind — Herzog Zwei meets FarmVille. The problem is that it’s addictive and expensive. I spoke to young people, students, who were spending too much money and neglecting their studies and other interests because of it. It took me longer than it should have to quit.

The game just like any online game it's either full of ads or over the top online purchases. When you reach a certain lvl after you have wasted your time in it will be very difficult to advance and compete without spending money on it. Which works as giant waste of time and money. The decent packages prices starts from £25 and up so better of buying a PS5.

Just a bit rubbish, really. Not enough gameplay possible, far too much going on within the game so you are constantly clicking to get through a myriad of different ways to spend more money. Silly sexualised game dialogue which is rather pathetic and unnecessary for the game context. Played for a while and yes you can progress to a level fairly rapidly but soon lose any challenge or interest.

Decent game. Upgrades take a very long time and quite pay 2 win. But even as a free player you can hang in there. The support team is awful. They don't get back to you in a timely matter at all. I've been waiting for an issue of mine for about a week now. They responded once and never again. So to sum it up decent game. At least 4 stars. But the support team ruined it for me so 2.

Yeah the ads are definitely misleading. Thought it was mainly a shooter game, but it's more like a city builder. Also, I feel like the women characters are overly sexualised with their outfits - there's one woman who you unlock in a bunny outfit - whereas the men are fully covered. Was cool at the very very beginning but got over it quick. Meh.

Not bad game, good when you need to switch off brain, you can play for free, but grinding is at speed of snail, which kill all the fun, at the time, feels like to much predatorial, and do everything it cans to force you spend money, the most selling point for me, was the babe arts, as man of culture, I loved this aspect, and flirt texting mini game was second best part, but after update, and listening feedback of school kids, they toned down the babe art, and make it kids friendly. bad move

really disappointed. was enjoying the game, but the app stopped working, had to reinstall and lost my account. tried contacting them via email, In game support over days with not a single reply. for a game that allows purchases the customer service should be there but unfortunately it seems non existing. shame as I really liked the game, just be careful if you play as you could easily loose your account too.

Like all the others. Pay to be strong etc. It's actually better than other like games, you get more recources for free etc and the graphics are better but in reality, if you want to attack people and feel superior you need to spend thousands of pounds. That being said, it's got a good community and does actually have the game you see advertised on youtube as a side quest

fun enough to keep me playing daily(3 weeks up to now). would be nice if there was more of the zombie shooter gameplay. it is available however there is frequen power spikes forcing u into resource management. the game is pay to win, for the most part I have not purchased anything. the odd little purchase here and there. if you want to be high power quickly then expect to pay alot

Updated to zero stars because of how they ignore paying customers. Spend your money elsewhere. The game is your typical repetitive tasks game, only saved at the start by the storyline. Unfortunately, one story in the whole game. Girl gets kidnapped, girl gets saved. Then collect resouces and fight forever without aim or purpose. Had great potential but failed by a storyteller giving up after one chapter.

this game gets overly complicated into a RTS builder mode without getting really entertaining due to lack of interesting gameplay. as such, it s a pretty standard p2w. sadly , the shooter side (the fun bit) is only available for a few mn per day. so you have basically have to be very patient and go through the tedious bits (or spend money ) in order to get to the fun bits.

Was good until Season 2. Now it takes hours to search through the map to find Season 2 tiles. The Devs think we don't have any real job other than playing this? The new Search function is useless as it only searches for nearby available tiles. I can see the pain being shared by many in our alliance. It's been a month I believe and why don't they act on feedbacks such as these !!! If not thoroughly tested, don't release stuff!

Too many times stuck at 50%, unable to login. Constant updates which break it Update: it appears the app didn't like my router having ALG setting turned on which shouldn't have any impact on the game. I find it odd that no one from support has contacted me to try and resolve my issues and get me to change my rating, obviously don't a give toss.

Latest update is final nail in the coffin for this game, developers have zero interest in gameplay or making it fun. this is solely a Pay To Play game, minimal rewards and packs are so astronomically priced you need to be a lottery winner to play. Some guys have spent anywhere from 25-50k so far on becoming the biggest. End result, they have 1 tank putting out more power than your entire setup. Now they remove the free teleport for players in this latest update, free to play are unwanted.

its very expensive, no longer can one be simply rewarded for gameplay. Take example of the latest dinosaur skin, it 64,000 candies which equates to rolls of 400-500 which cost £600. only very few have it. the game is pay to win. i am losing interest in the game. they are dragging out season 3 which by all accounts are linked to 2. which was tiles caused more trouble than worth. absolutely no skill needed just big pockets 🤣.

i wanted a basic time killer game and after reading the many reviews, after see ad on another game and while you do attack zombies like the ad but that is less than 5% of the gameplay, you need to upgrade base and other buildings to continue that gameplay. just like the many other mobile games out there, build city, buildings, upgrade, attack cities, other syndicates and 200+ of packages to buy. this game is p2w on steroids, shop icons overload screen, time to drop it and stop wasting time, bye.

Good game, but there's no need for the overly sexualised female characters. The men are dressed in police uniforms, and early on, you "unlock" or "win" a woman in a bunny outfit. Then, the nurse in pretty much a stripper nurse costume. Then a very sexy female police officer. I think the women could be in normal outfits. This was all in the first 10 mins. This is why I uninstalled it. Then I read the reviews, and I'm glad I did as its just another play to win game...sigh

the ads are kinda misleading, it's a survival game with shooting, not a shooter. uninstalled because it's not what I wanted. good game though just I don't want to log in everyday just to do tasks. there's online chat but nothing to talk about. and it's just the same core mechanics as any survival game. at least with empires I know what I'm getting.

In some bits it's advertised like how you see it on the adverts, but only a small part of the game. But the female characters are so overly sexualised it's disgusting. Like you can make an amazing character without having to have her cleavage and underwear show and people would still continue to play it. It would be a great game if they could actually make the female characters more realistic, because why are the men all covered up while the women are barely dressed?! It's vile and dehumanising.
